grader.scenario: Voicemail mailbox PIN locked after repeated incorrect attempts while awaiting medical call
grader.notes: Exemplary support call where the agent demonstrated outstanding empathy, professionalism, and prompt technical ownership to unlock a panicked customer's voicemail awaiting urgent hospital biopsy results.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Deena warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent acknowledged customer panic and medical anxiety at [01:45]: 'I understand how crucial and distressing this is, Deena. Let us get this unlocked without any delay.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the voicemail lockout and hospital urgency accurately at [01:15].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed mobile number accurately without asking for previously supplied details.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent took immediate ownership and successfully resolved voicemail access.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, compassionate, and professional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked effective diagnostic questions regarding mailbox error prompts and device behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer successfully dialled 121, set new PIN, listened to hospital voicemail, and confirmed clear biopsy results.
